dabble_in_darkness.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，放逐你牌库顶的一张牌。此牌获得-X力量，X为以此方式放逐的牌的资源数值。
血债
dabble_in_darkness.text_en:
When this attacks, banish the top card of your deck. This gets -X{p}, where X is the pitch value of the card banished this way.
Blood Debt

daily_grind.text_zh:
你控制的攻击行动牌获得“当此牌防御时，与攻击英雄交锋。胜者摧毁另一位英雄牌库顶的一张牌。”
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌。
daily_grind.text_en:
Attack action cards you control get "When this defends, clash with the attacking hero. The winner destroys the top card of the other hero's deck."
At the start of your turn, destroy this.

dampen.text_zh:
对任意目标造成4点秘法伤害。
防止本回合接下来将对你的英雄造成的X点秘法伤害，X为阻尼造成的伤害。
dampen.text_en:
Deal 4 arcane damage to any target.
Prevent the next X arcane damage that would be dealt to your hero this turn, where X is the damage dealt by Dampen.

dance_of_darkness.text_zh:
若你的英雄将受到伤害，你可以放逐此牌以防止其中2点伤害。
血债
dance_of_darkness.text_en:
If your hero would be dealt damage, you may banish this to prevent 2 of that damage.
Blood Debt

danger_digits.type_zh: 刺客·忍者 装备·手臂
danger_digits.text_zh: 攻击反应——摧毁此牌：你控制的、不在当前链环上的目标匕首对防御英雄造成1点伤害。若以此方式造成伤害，该匕首视为命中。摧毁该匕首。
danger_digits.text_en: Attack Reaction - Destroy this: Target dagger you control that isn't on the active chain link deals 1 damage to the defending hero. If damage is dealt this way, the dagger has hit. Destroy the dagger.

darling_of_the_crowd.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若本回合你被欢呼过，它获得+1防御。
darling_of_the_crowd.text_en: While this is defending, if you've been cheered this turn, it gets +1{d}.

dash.text_zh: 你可以以竞技场中一张费用为2或更低的机械师物品开始游戏。
dash.text_en: You may start the game with a Mechanologist item with cost 2 or less in the arena.

dash_database.text_zh:
你随时可以查看你牌库顶的一张牌。
每回合一次，你可以将你牌库顶的一张费用为0或1的机械师物品当作瞬间使用。它的使用费用额外增加1点资源。
dash_database.text_en:
You may look at the top card of your deck at any time.
Once per turn, you may play a Mechanologist item with cost 0 or 1 from the top of your deck as though it were an instant. It costs an additional {r} to play.

dash_i_o.text_zh:
你随时可以查看你牌库顶的一张牌。
每回合一次，你可以将你牌库顶的一张费用为0或1的机械师物品当作瞬间使用。它的使用费用额外增加1点资源。
dash_i_o.text_en:
You may look at the top card of your deck at any time.
Once per turn, you may play a Mechanologist item with cost 0 or 1 from the top of your deck as though it were an instant. It costs an additional {r} to play.

dash_inventor_extraordinaire.text_zh: 你可以以竞技场中一张费用为2或更低的机械师物品开始游戏。
dash_inventor_extraordinaire.text_en: You may start the game with a Mechanologist item with cost 2 or less in the arena.

dashing_flashfoot.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
dashing_flashfoot.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。”
此牌第一次对英雄造成伤害时，创造一个闪电化身衍生物。
dashing_flashfoot.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p} and "When this attacks a hero, deal 1 arcane damage to them."
The first time this deals damage to a hero, create an Embodiment of Lightning token.

data_doll_mkii.text_zh: 每当一张费用为2或更低的机械师物品从你的牌库被置入你的放逐区时，将其放入竞技场。
data_doll_mkii.text_en: Whenever a Mechanologist item with cost 2 or less is put into your banished zone from your deck, put it into the arena.

data_link.text_zh:
推进
当此牌命中时，占卜1。

dauntless.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次武器攻击获得+3力量。
本回合防御英雄使用的下一张防御反应牌费用额外增加1点资源。
再动
dauntless.text_en:
Your next weapon attack this turn gains +3{p}.
The next defense reaction card the defending hero plays this turn costs an additional {r} to play.
Go again

dawnblade.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
每回合第二次此牌命中时，在其上放置一个+1力量指示物。
在你的结束阶段开始时，若本回合此牌没有命中过，从其上移除所有+1力量指示物。
dawnblade.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
The second time this hits each turn, put a +1{p} counter on it.
At the beginning of your end phase, if this hasn't hit this turn, remove all +1{p} counters from it.

dawnblade_resplendent.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：攻击
每回合你第二次用此牌攻击时，它直到回合结束获得+1力量。
dawnblade_resplendent.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}: Attack
The second time you attack with this each turn, it gets +1{p} until end of turn.

dazzling_crescendo.type_zh: 元素 游侠 行动·箭矢 攻击
dazzling_crescendo.text_zh:
闪电融合
若炫目渐强已融合，它获得再动。
dazzling_crescendo.text_en:
Lightning Fusion
If Dazzling Crescendo was fused, it gains go again.

dead_eye.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次箭矢攻击获得+3力量。
若其带有一个瞄准指示物，它获得“当此牌命中英雄时，查看其手牌并选择一张牌。该英雄弃掉它。”
再动
dead_eye.text_en:
Your next arrow attack this turn gains +3{p}.
If it has an aim counter, it gains "When this hits a hero, look at their hand and choose a card. They discard it."
Go again

dead_threads.text_zh:
瞬间——横置此牌：获得1点资源。仅当本回合有一个盟友被置入你的坟场时才能启动此异能。
刃碎
dead_threads.text_en:
Instant - {t}: Gain {r}. Activate this only if an ally has been put into your graveyard this turn.
Blade Break

deadly_display.text_zh: 目标武器攻击获得+2力量。若该武器本回合被磨砺过，该攻击获得“当此牌命中英雄时，创造一个连击衍生物。”
deadly_display.text_en: Target weapon attack gets +2{p}. If the weapon has been sharpened this turn, the attack gets "When this hits a hero, create a Flurry token."

deadly_duo.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，本战斗链中你使用的下一张基础力量为2或更低的攻击行动牌获得+2力量。
再动
deadly_duo.text_en:
When this hits, the next attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play this combat chain gains +2 {p}.
Go again

deadwood_dirge.text_zh:
摧毁你控制的一个光环。若如此做，创造3个符文吟唱衍生物。
再动
deadwood_dirge.text_en:
Destroy an aura you control. If you do, create 3 Runechant tokens.
Go again

deadwood_rumbler.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
deadwood_rumbler.text_zh:
抽一张牌，然后随机弃一张牌。若以此方式弃置的是力量为6或更高的牌，从某个坟场中放逐一张牌。
血债
deadwood_rumbler.text_en:
Draw a card then discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more {p} is discarded this way, banish a card from a graveyard.
Blood Debt

dealers_grip.text_zh:
攻击反应——支付2点资源，摧毁此牌：目标已下注的攻击获得+1力量。
战痕
dealers_grip.text_en:
Attack Reaction - {r}{r}, destroy this: Target attack that has wagered gets +1{p}.
Battleworn

death_dealer.text_zh: 每回合一次行动——支付1点资源：若你军械库中没有牌，你可以将你手牌中的一张箭矢牌正面朝上放入你的军械库。若如此做，抽一张牌。再动
death_dealer.text_en: Once per Turn Action - {r}: If you have no cards in your arsenal, you may put an arrow card from your hand face up into your arsenal. If you do, draw a card. Go again

death_touch.type_zh: 刺客·游侠 行动·攻击
death_touch.text_zh:
死亡之触不能从手牌使用。
当此牌命中英雄时，在其控制下创造一个虚弱、惰性或血腐疫病衍生物。
death_touch.text_en:
Death Touch can't be played from hand.
When this hits a hero, create a Frailty, Inertia, or Bloodrot Pox token under their control.

deathly_delight.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_delight.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，获得与本回合失去过生命的英雄数量相等的生命。
血债
deathly_delight.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, gain {h} equal to the number of heroes who have lost {h} this turn.
Blood Debt

deathly_duet.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_duet.text_zh: 当死亡二重奏攻击时，若你为使用此牌资源过一张攻击行动牌，它获得+2力量。若你为使用此牌资源过一张“非攻击”行动牌，创造2个符文吟唱衍生物。
deathly_duet.text_en: When Deathly Duet attacks, if an attack action card was pitched to play it, it gains +2{p}. If a 'non-attack' action card was pitched to play it, create 2 Runechant tokens.

deathly_wail.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deathly_wail.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，创造与本回合失去过生命的英雄数量相等的符文吟唱衍生物。
血债
deathly_wail.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, create Runechant tokens equal to the number of heroes who have lost {h} this turn.
Blood Debt

deathmatch_arena.text_zh:
传奇
再动
英雄可以攻击任意对手英雄。
当一位英雄对另一位英雄造成致命伤害时，该英雄创造与开局时英雄数量等量的金币衍生物。
deathmatch_arena.text_en:
Legendary
Go again
Heroes can attack any opposing hero.
When a hero deals lethal damage to another hero, they create Gold tokens equal to the number of heroes who started this game.

debilitate.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，该英雄在其下一个回合期间的第一次攻击获得-2力量。
debilitate.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, their first attack during their next turn gets -2{p}.

decimator_great_axe.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击
每回合第一次此牌被非装备牌防御时，目标防御牌的基础防御减半（向上取整），直到回合结束。
decimator_great_axe.text_en:
Once per Turn Action - {r}{r}{r}:  Attack
The first time this is defended by a non-equipment card each turn, halve the base {d} of target defending card, rounded up, until end of turn.

deep_blue.text_zh: 行动——将你手牌中的一张牌置于牌库底，摧毁此牌：获得3点资源。再动
deep_blue.text_en: Action - Put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck, destroy this: Gain {r}{r}{r}. Go again

deep_blue_sea.text_zh: 本回合你每资源过一张蓝色牌，此牌获得+1力量。
deep_blue_sea.text_en: This gets +1{p} for each blue card you've pitched this turn.

deep_recesses_of_existence.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deep_recesses_of_existence.text_zh:
符文之门
当战斗链关闭时，你可以牌面朝下放逐此牌。若如此做，为本回合失去过生命的每位英雄，从他们的坟场中放逐一张牌。
血债
deep_recesses_of_existence.text_en:
Rune Gate
When the combat chain closes, you may banish this face-down. If you do, for each hero who has lost {h} this turn, banish a card from their graveyard.
Blood Debt

deep_rooted_evil.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
deep_rooted_evil.text_zh:
若本回合有一张力量为6或更高的牌被置入你的放逐区，你可以从你的放逐区使用深植的邪恶。
血债
deep_rooted_evil.text_en:
If a card with 6 or more {p} has been put into your banished zone this turn, you may play Deep Rooted Evil from your banished zone.
Blood Debt

defang_the_dragon.text_zh:
隐匿
契约——你受契约束缚以命中一位名为方格的被标记英雄。每当你完成此契约时，抽一张牌。
defang_the_dragon.text_en:
Stealth
Contract - You are contracted to hit a marked hero named Fang. Whenever you complete this contract, draw a card.

defender_of_daybreak.text_zh: 当此牌防御暗影攻击时，本战斗链中非装备光牌获得+1防御。
defender_of_daybreak.text_en: When this defends a Shadow attack, non-equipment Light cards get +1{d} this combat chain.

demolition_crew.text_zh:
作为使用拆迁队的额外费用，展示你手牌中一张费用为2或更高的牌。
支配
demolition_crew.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Demolition Crew, reveal a card in your hand with cost 2 or greater.
Dominate

demolition_protocol.text_zh: 进化升级——当此牌攻击英雄时，从其控制的至多X件装备、物品和/或武器上移除所有蒸汽指示物，X为你已装备的进化装备数量。
demolition_protocol.text_en: Evo Upgrade - When this attacks a hero, remove all steam counters from up to X equipment, items, and/or weapons they control, where X is the number of Evos you have equipped.

demonstrate_devotion.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
demonstrate_devotion.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。”
demonstrate_devotion.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this attacks a hero, create a Fealty token."

den_of_the_spider.type_zh: 刺客·战士 行动 防御反应·陷阱
den_of_the_spider.text_zh: 当此牌防御力量大于其基础的攻击时，标记攻击英雄。
den_of_the_spider.text_en: When this defends an attack with {p} greater than its base, mark the attacking hero.

dense_blue_mist.text_zh:
本回合以你为目标的攻击获得-1力量。
若你为使用此牌资源过一张气，本回合攻击命中你时效果不触发。
dense_blue_mist.text_en:
Attacks that target you this turn get -1{p}.
If a Chi was pitched to play this, effects don't trigger if an attack hits you this turn.

deny_redemption.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
deny_redemption.text_zh:
当此牌攻击生命比你高的英雄时，对其造成1点秘法伤害。该伤害不能被防止。
瞬间——弃掉此牌：本回合英雄不能获得生命。
deny_redemption.text_en:
When this attacks a hero with more {h} than you, deal 1 arcane damage to them. This damage can't be prevented.
Instant - Discard this: Heroes can't gain {h} this turn.

depths_of_despair.text_zh:
当此牌防御时，当战斗链关闭时放逐它。
血债
depths_of_despair.text_en:
When this defends, banish it when the combat chain closes.
Blood Debt

descend_into_madness.text_zh: 随机放逐防御英雄手牌中的一张牌，然后该英雄抽一张牌。
descend_into_madness.text_en: Banish a random card from the defending hero's hand, then they draw a card.

descendent_gustwave.text_zh:
连击——若激涌打击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源并获得+2力量。
再动
descendent_gustwave.text_en:
Combo - If Surging Strike was the last attack this combat chain, this costs {r} less to play and has +2{p}.
Go again

desires_of_flesh.text_zh:
隐匿
当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的一张牌。
每当此牌放逐一张攻击行动牌时，获得1点生命。
desires_of_flesh.text_en:
Stealth
When this hits a hero, banish the top card of their deck.
Whenever this banishes an attack action card, gain 1{h}.

destructive_aethertide.text_zh:
对任意目标造成1点秘法伤害。
激涌——若此牌对英雄造成超过1点伤害，摧毁其军械库中的一张牌。
destructive_aethertide.text_en:
Deal 1 arcane damage to any target.
Surge - If this deals more than 1 damage to a hero, destroy a card in their arsenal.

destructive_deliberation.text_zh: 当此牌命中英雄时，创造一个沉思衍生物。
destructive_deliberation.text_en: When this hits a hero, create a Ponder token.

destructive_fleetfoot.type_zh: 闪电 符文剑士 行动·攻击
destructive_fleetfoot.text_zh:
速击——若此牌具有再动，它获得+1力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个光环衍生物。
destructive_fleetfoot.text_en:
Quickstrike - If this has go again, it gets +1{p}.
When this hits a hero, destroy an aura token they control.

destructive_tendencies.text_zh:
选择其一或全部；
从目标物品衍生物上移除所有指示物。
从目标光环衍生物上移除所有指示物。

devotion_never_dies.text_zh:
当此牌命中时，若一张龙裔攻击是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，放逐此牌。若如此做，本回合你可以使用它。
再动
devotion_never_dies.text_en:
When this hits, if a Draconic attack was the last attack this combat chain, banish this. If you do, you may play it this turn.
Go again

diabolic_offering.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
diabolic_offering.text_zh:
若本回合有一张力量为6或更高的牌被置入你的放逐区，恶魔献祭的力量和防御为6。否则，它们为0。
血债
diabolic_offering.text_en:
If a card with 6 ore more {p} has been put into your banished zone this turn, Daibolic Offering's {p} and {d} are 6, otherwise they are 0.
Blood Debt

diabolic_ultimatum.text_zh:
若你为使用恶魔最后通牒资源过一张攻击行动牌，每位英雄选择并摧毁其控制的一个盟友。
若你为使用恶魔最后通牒资源过一张“非攻击”行动牌，每位英雄选择并摧毁其控制的一个光环。
diabolic_ultimatum.text_en:
If an attack action card was pitched to play Diabolic Ultimatum, each hero chooses and destroys an ally they control.
If a 'non-attack' action card was pitched to play Diabolic Ultimatum, each hero chooses and destroys an aura they control.

diadem_of_dreamstate.text_zh:
每回合一次，当此牌或你控制的具有结界的非衍生物永久物被摧毁时，你可以支付1点资源。若如此做，创造一个沉思衍生物。
结界2
diadem_of_dreamstate.text_en:
Once per turn, when this or a non-token permanent you control with ward is destroyed, you may pay {r}. If you do, create a Ponder token.
Ward 2

diamond.text_zh: 行动——摧毁钻石：抽一张牌。再动
diamond.text_en: Action - Destroy Diamond: Draw a card. Go again

diamond_amulet.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：获得1个行动点。
水葬传说
diamond_amulet.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: gain 1 action point.
Legend of the Watery Grave

diamond_hands.text_zh:
鲁迪专精
在你的结束阶段开始时，若你手牌中有4张或更多牌，创造一个钻石衍生物。
刃碎
diamond_hands.text_en:
Ruu'di Specialization
At the beginning of your end phase, if you have 4 or more cards in hand, create a Diamond token.
Blade Break

dice_up.text_zh: 目标武器攻击获得“当此牌命中英雄时，你可以从此武器上移除一个+1力量指示物。若如此做，摧毁其控制的一个光环。”
dice_up.text_en: Target weapon attack gets "When this hits a hero, you may remove a +1{p} counter from this weapon. If you do, destroy an aura they control."

diced.text_zh:
目标匕首攻击获得+1力量。
你本回合的下一次匕首攻击获得+3力量。
diced.text_en:
Target dagger attack gets +1{p}.
Your next dagger attack this turn gets +3{p}.

didnt_see_that_coming.text_zh: 每位生命高于你的英雄弃一张牌。
didnt_see_that_coming.text_en: Each hero who has more {h} than you discards a card.

dig_in.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，你可以支付至多3点资源。创造等量的坚韧衍生物。
dig_in.text_en: When this defends, you may pay up to {r}{r}{r}. Create that many Toughness tokens.

dig_up_dinner.text_zh:
选择你坟场中的3张随机牌。将以此方式选择的所有力量为6或更高的攻击行动牌洗入你的牌库，然后获得等量生命。放逐此牌。
再动
dig_up_dinner.text_en:
Choose 3 random cards in your graveyard. Shuffle all attack action cards with 6 or more {p} chosen this way into your deck, then gain that much {h}. Banish this.
Go again

dimenxxional_crossroads.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动·光环
dimenxxional_crossroads.text_zh:
再动
每当你从放逐区使用攻击行动牌或“非攻击”行动牌时，若本回合你尚未使用过另一张该类型的牌，对目标英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
若你在你的回合期间失去生命，摧毁维度十字路口。
dimenxxional_crossroads.text_en:
Go again
Whenever you play an attack action card or a 'non-attack' action card from the banished zone, if you haven't played another card of that type this turn, deal 1 arcane damage to target hero.
If you lose {h} during your turn, destroy Dimenxxional Crossroads.

dimenxxional_gateway.type_zh: 暗影 符文剑士 行动
dimenxxional_gateway.text_zh:
占卜3
展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为符文剑士牌，对每位对手英雄造成1点秘法伤害。若其为暗影牌，你可以放逐它。
再动
dimenxxional_gateway.text_en:
Opt 3
Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Runeblade card, deal 1 arcane damage to each opposing hero. If it's a Shadow card, you may banish it.
Go again

dimenxxional_vortex.text_zh:
你可以从你的放逐区使用此牌。若如此做，它的使用费用减少2点资源。
每位英雄放逐其军械库中的一张牌。
血债
dimenxxional_vortex.text_en:
You may play this from your banished zone. If you do, it costs {r}{r} less to play.
Each hero banishes a card from their arsenal.
Blood Debt

disable.text_zh: 粉碎——当此牌对英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，将其军械库中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
disable.text_en: Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a hero, put a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck.

disarm.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你被欢呼过，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
当此牌防御时，若其防御为6或更高，攻击英雄将手牌中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
disarm.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've been cheered this turn, create a Toughness token.
When this defends, if it has 6 or more {d}, the attacking hero puts a card from their hand on the bottom of their deck.

disdainful_delight.text_zh: 当此牌防御时，若本回合你被喝倒彩过，此牌获得+1防御。
disdainful_delight.text_en: While this is defending, if you've been booed this turn, this gets +1{d}.

disembody.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你被欢呼过，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
当此牌防御时，若其防御为6或更高，攻击英雄将其控制的一个光环置于其牌库底。
disembody.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've been cheered this turn, create a Toughness token.
When this defends, if it has 6 or more {d}, the attacking hero puts an aura they control on the bottom of their deck.

disenchantment_of_the_old_ones.text_zh:
粉碎——当此牌对守护者英雄造成4点或更多伤害时，摧毁其控制的所有光环。
重掷2
disenchantment_of_the_old_ones.text_en:
Crush - When this deals 4 or more damage to a Guardian hero, destroy all auras they control.
Heave 2

dishonor.text_zh:
连击——若先祖纽带是本战斗链的最后一次攻击，此牌获得+2力量。
当此牌命中英雄时，若你控制激涌打击、后继阵风波和先祖纽带，该英雄在剩余游戏中失去所有异能。
dishonor.text_en:
Combo - If Bonds of Ancestry was the last attack this combat chain, this has +2{p}.
When this hits a hero, if you control Surging Strike, Descendent Gustwave, and Bonds of Ancestry, that hero loses all abilities for the rest of the game.

disperse.text_zh:
当此牌攻击时，若本回合你被欢呼过，创造一个坚韧衍生物。
当此牌防御时，若其防御为6或更高，攻击英雄将其军械库中的一张牌置于其牌库底。
disperse.text_en:
When this attacks, if you've been cheered this turn, create a Toughness token.
When this defends, if it has 6 or more {d}, the attacking hero puts a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck.

display_loyalty.type_zh: 龙裔 忍者 行动·攻击
display_loyalty.text_zh: 若你控制2个或更多龙裔链环，此牌获得再动，以及“当此牌攻击英雄时，创造一个效忠衍生物。”
display_loyalty.text_en: If you control 2 or more Draconic chain links, this gets go again and "When this attacks a hero, create a Fealty token."

display_of_artistry.text_zh: 目标武器攻击获得+3力量。若该武器本回合被磨砺过，该攻击获得“当防御此牌时，反应牌获得-1防御。”
display_of_artistry.text_en: Target weapon attack gets +3{p}. If the weapon has been sharpened this turn, the attack gets "Reaction cards get -1{d} while defending this."

display_of_craftsmanship.text_zh: 目标武器攻击获得+4力量。若该武器本回合被磨砺过，在其上放置一个+1力量指示物。
display_of_craftsmanship.text_en: Target weapon attack gets +4{p}. If the weapon has been sharpened this turn, put a +1{p} counter on it.

dissipation_shield.text_zh:
消散护盾进入竞技场时带有4个蒸汽指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
瞬间——摧毁消散护盾：本回合你的英雄下一次将受到伤害时，防止X点伤害，X为消散护盾上的蒸汽指示物数量。
dissipation_shield.text_en:
Dissipation Shield enters the arena with 4 steam counters on it.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Dissipation Shield unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Instant - Destroy Dissipation Shield: The next time your hero would be dealt damage this turn, prevent X damage, where X is the number of steam counters on Dissipation Shield.

dissolution_sphere.text_zh:
溶解球体进入竞技场时带有一个蒸汽指示物。
在你的行动阶段开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
每当你的英雄将受到恰好1点伤害时，防止它。
dissolution_sphere.text_en:
Dissolution Sphere enters the arena with a steam counter on it.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy Dissolution Sphere unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Whenever your hero would be dealt exactly 1 damage, prevent it.

dissolve_reality.text_zh:
每位英雄将其军械库中的所有牌置于其牌库底并创造一个沉思衍生物。
再动
dissolve_reality.text_en:
Each hero puts all cards in their arsenal on the bottom of their deck and creates a Ponder token.
Go again

dissolving_shield.text_zh:
上弦
此牌进入竞技场时带有3个蒸汽指示物。在你的回合开始时，除非你从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物，否则摧毁它。
瞬间——从此牌上移除一个蒸汽指示物：防止本回合接下来将对你造成的1点伤害。若此牌没有蒸汽指示物，摧毁它。
dissolving_shield.text_en:
Crank
This enters the arena with 3 steam counters. At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter from it.
Instant - Remove a steam counter from this: Prevent the next 1 damage that would be dealt to you this turn. If this has no steam counters, destroy it.

distant_rumbling.text_zh:
当此牌进入竞技场时，抽一张牌，然后将你手牌中的一张牌放入你的牌库的从上往下第五张的位置。
在你的回合开始时，摧毁此牌，然后创造3个地震涌动衍生物。
distant_rumbling.text_en:
When this enters the arena, draw a card, then put a card from your hand into your deck fifth from the top.
At the start of your turn, destroy this, then create 3 Seismic Surge tokens.

disturb_the_peace.text_zh:
此牌不能被守护者光环防御。
当此牌命中守护者英雄时，摧毁其控制的一个光环。
disturb_the_peace.text_en:
This can't be defended by Guardian auras.
When this hits a Guardian hero, destroy an aura they control.

dive_through_data.text_zh:
推进
当此牌命中时，占卜1。

divvy_up.text_zh:
从宝藏之岛上移除一半的金币指示物（向上取整）。若你为盗贼，改为移除全部。
创造与此方式移除的金币指示物数量相等的金币衍生物。
divvy_up.text_en:
Remove half the gold counters from Treasure Island, rounded up. If you are a Thief, instead remove all of them.
Create Gold tokens equal to the number of gold counters removed this way.

dominate_the_competition.text_zh: 你本回合的下一次攻击获得支配。
dominate_the_competition.text_en: Your next attack this turn gets dominate.

dominia.text_zh: 每当多米尼亚攻击英雄时，展示你牌库顶的一张牌。若其为红色牌，查看该英雄的手牌并从其中放逐一张牌。
dominia.text_en: Whenever Dominia attacks a hero, reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a red card, look at their hand and banish a card from it.

donkey.text_zh: 目标剑攻击获得+1力量，并与防御英雄下注。胜者摧毁自己军械库中的一张牌。
donkey.text_en: Target sword attack gets +1{p} and wagers with the defending hero. The winner destroys a card in their own arsenal.

doomsaying.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·光环
doomsaying.text_zh:
再动
在你的结束阶段开始时，在此牌上放置一个末日指示物，然后每位英雄摧毁其控制的X个光环，X为此牌上的末日指示物数量。
doomsaying.text_en:
Go again
At the beginning of your end phase, put a doom counter on this, then each hero destroys X auras they control, where X is the number of doom counters on this.

doomsday.text_zh:
传奇莱维娅专精
仅当你放逐区中有6张或更多具有血债的牌时才能使用末日。
创造一个灵魂收割者·布拉兹莫菲特衍生物。
doomsday.text_en:
Legendary Levia Specialization
Play Doomsday only if there are 6 or more cards with blood debt in your banished zone.
Create a Blasmophet, the Soul Harvester token.

dorinthea.text_zh: 每回合一次效果——当你控制的武器命中时，本回合你可以用该武器额外攻击一次。
dorinthea.text_en: Once per turn Effect - When a weapon you control hits, you may attack an additional time with that weapon this turn.

dorinthea_ironsong.text_zh: 每回合一次效果——当你控制的武器命中时，本回合你可以用该武器额外攻击一次。
dorinthea_ironsong.text_en: Once per turn Effect - When a weapon you control hits, you may attack an additional time with that weapon this turn.

dorinthea_quicksilver_prodigy.text_zh: 每回合你的辉煌黎明之刃的攻击第一次获得再动时，本回合你可以用它额外攻击一次。
dorinthea_quicksilver_prodigy.text_en: The first time your Dawnblade, Resplendent's attack gets go again each turn, you may attack an additional time with it this turn.

double_cross_strap.text_zh:
瞬间——摧毁此牌：获得1点资源。仅当本战斗链中你命中两次或更多时才能启动此异能。
秘法屏障1
double_cross_strap.text_en:
Instant - Destroy this: Gain {r}. Activate this only if you've hit 2 or more times this combat chain.
Arcane Barrier 1

double_down.text_zh:
你可以摧毁你控制的一个金币，而非支付加倍下注的费用。
本回合下一次下注的攻击获得+3力量和压制。
若本回合一位英雄将因下注创造1个或更多衍生物，改为其创造数量加1的每种这些衍生物。
再动
double_down.text_en:
You may destroy a Gold you control rather than pay Double Down's {r} cost.
The next attack that wagers this turn gets +3{p} and overpower.
If a hero would create 1 or more tokens from a wager this turn, instead they create that many plus 1 of each of those tokens.
Go again

double_strike.text_zh:
当双重打击的链环结算时，放逐它。本战斗链中你可以使用它。若如此做，它失去此异能。
再动
double_strike.text_en:
When Double Strike's chain link resolves, banish it. You may play it this combat chain. If you do, it loses this ability.
Go again

double_trouble.text_zh:
隐匿
若此链环中你使用或启动过2张或更多攻击反应，此牌获得+2力量，以及“当此牌命中英雄时，放逐其牌库顶的2张牌。”
double_trouble.text_en:
Stealth
If you've played or activated 2 or more attack reactions this chain link, this gets +2{p} and "When this hits a hero, banish the top 2 cards of their deck."

doubling_season.text_zh: 当此牌在任意区域正面朝上时，若它将获得力量，改为它获得等量加1的力量。
doubling_season.text_en: While this is face-up in any zone, if it would gain {p}, instead it gains that much plus 1.

douse_in_runeblood.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
douse_in_runeblood.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，创造与你本回合使用过的非攻击行动牌数量相等的符文吟唱衍生物。若以此方式创造了3个或更多符文吟唱，此牌获得再动。
douse_in_runeblood.text_en: When this attacks, create Runechant tokens equal to the number of non-attack action cards you've played this turn. If 3 or more Runechants are created this way, this gets go again.

down_and_dirty.text_zh: 当下三滥在你的军械库中时，你可以用它防御。
down_and_dirty.text_en: While Down and Dirty is in your arsenal, you may defend with it.

down_but_not_out.text_zh: 当此牌攻击英雄时，若你的生命较低且控制的装备和衍生物较少，此牌获得+3力量、压制，以及“当此牌命中时，创造敏捷、力量、活力衍生物各一个。”
down_but_not_out.text_en: When this attacks a hero, if you have less {h} and control fewer equipment and tokens than them, this gets +3{p}, overpower, and "When this hits, create an Agility, Might, and Vigor token."

downswing.text_zh: 目标剑攻击获得+1力量，并与防御英雄下注。胜者失去1点生命。
downswing.text_en: Target sword attack gets +1{p} and wagers with the defending hero. The winner loses 1{h}.

draco_fire.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次龙裔攻击获得+2力量，且使用或启动费用减少1点资源。
当此牌在你坟场中时，在你的回合开始时，你可以放逐你坟场中的2张名为德拉科之火的牌。若如此做，获得1点资源。
draco_fire.text_en:
Your next Draconic attack this turn gets +2{p} and costs {r} less to play or activate.
While this is in your graveyard, at the start of your turn, you may banish 2 cards named Draco Fire from your graveyard. If you do, gain {r}.

dracona_optimai.text_zh: 每当德拉科娜·奥普提迈攻击英雄时，展示你牌库顶的3张牌。他对该英雄或其控制的一个盟友造成与此方式展示的红色牌数量两倍相等的秘法伤害。
dracona_optimai.text_en: Whenever Dracona Optimai attacks a hero, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. He deals arcane damage equal to twice the number of red cards revealed this way to them or an ally they control.

drag_down.text_zh: 当此牌防御攻击时，它获得-3力量。
drag_down.text_en: When this defends an attack, it gets -3{p}.

dragon_power.text_zh: 当此牌攻击时，若其为龙裔，它获得+3力量。
dragon_power.text_en: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets +3{p}.

dragonscaler_flight_path.text_zh:
瞬间——支付3点资源，摧毁此牌：目标龙裔攻击获得再动。若其为武器或盟友攻击，本回合你可以用它额外攻击一次。每当你控制一个龙裔链环，此异能费用减少1点资源。
战痕
dragonscaler_flight_path.text_en:
Instant - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Target Draconic attack gets go again. If it's a weapon or ally attack, you may attack with it an additional time this turn. This ability costs {r} less to activate for each Draconic chain link you control.
Battleworn

dramatic_pause.text_zh:
悬念
当此牌进入竞技场时，此链环中目标防御行动牌获得+3防御。
dramatic_pause.text_en:
Suspense
When this enters the arena, target defending action card gets +3{d} this chain link.

draw_a_crowd.text_zh:
再动
当此牌进入竞技场时，每位英雄抽一张牌。
在你的行动阶段开始时，摧毁此牌，然后你本回合使用的下一张守护者攻击行动牌获得+3力量。
draw_a_crowd.text_en:
Go again
When this enters the arena, each hero draws a card.
At the beginning of your action phase, destroy this, then the next Guardian attack action card you play this turn gets +3{p}.

draw_back_the_hammer.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次机械师攻击获得+4力量。
你可以重置你控制的一把枪。
再动
draw_back_the_hammer.text_en:
Your next Mechanologist attack this turn gets +4{p}.
You may {u} a gun you control.
Go again

draw_swords.text_zh:
你本回合的下一次战士攻击获得+3力量。
抽一张牌。
再动
draw_swords.text_en:

Draw a card.

drawing_dead.text_zh: 目标剑攻击获得+1力量，并与防御英雄下注。胜者弃一张牌。
drawing_dead.text_en: Target sword attack gets +1{p} and wagers with the defending hero. The winner discards a card.

drawn_to_the_blade.text_zh:
磨砺你控制的目标剑。
若其上有2个或更多+1力量指示物，本回合它下一次命中时，抽一张牌。
再动
drawn_to_the_blade.text_en:
Sharpen target sword you control.

Go again

drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.type_zh: 符文剑士 行动·攻击
drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.text_zh:
每当你控制一个符文吟唱，此牌的使用费用减少1点资源。
当此牌攻击时，抽一张牌。
drawn_to_the_dark_dimension.text_en:
This costs {r} less to play for each Runechant you control.
When this attacks, draw a card.

dread_screamer.type_zh: 暗影 蛮将 行动·攻击
dread_screamer.text_zh:
作为使用恐惧尖叫者的额外费用，随机放逐你坟场中的3张牌。
若以此方式放逐的是一张力量为6或更高的牌，恐惧尖叫者获得再动。
血债
dread_screamer.text_en:
As an additional cost to play Dread Screamer, banish 3 random cards from your graveyard
If a card with 6 or more {p} is banished this way, Dread Screamer gains go again.
Blood Debt

dread_scythe.type_zh: 符文剑士 武器·Scythe （双手）
dread_scythe.text_zh:
每回合一次行动——支付3点资源：攻击
每当你用恐惧镰刀攻击时，对防御英雄造成1点秘法伤害。
被恐惧镰刀造成伤害的英雄在其下一个行动阶段期间不能获得生命。
dread_scythe.text_en:
